data.name: Nathan
data.gender_notes: Nathan is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Natan, from the root n-t-n, 'to give'. Its root is Hebrew n-t-n. Nathan the prophet (2 Samuel 7). Nathan is a Hebrew name meaning “He gave; gift”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Nathan expresses “He gave; gift”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Hebrew Natan, from the root n-t-n, 'to give'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nathan total 22, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.
